summary: Closure review of cand-002-gvr-loop. The run is a well‑documented, fully preregistered paired confirmatory experiment with comprehensive artifact provenance. Execution and analysis are internally consistent and reproducible. The reported outcome is a reproducible ceiling/null result (baseline=200/200; guarded=200/200; paired difference=0.00; McNemar p=1.00). One required revision from the prior terminal review remains unresolved: the manuscript does not present an aggregated summary (counts/percentages) of task difficulty levels and validator coverage across the full K=200 sample to support the claim that the sampled pool produced a ceiling regime. Other earlier required clarifications (degenerate CI explanation; shared_initial_generation constraint; repair never invoked) are addressed in the manuscript. Provide the requested aggregate summary and add explicit one‑sentence statements in the Abstract and Conclusion that the preregistered hypothesis H1 was not supported (no detectable marginal effect under the tested regime). After these targeted, artifact‑grounded edits the paper will be acceptable.
critical_issues: Manuscript lacks an aggregated summary (counts and percentages) of task difficulty levels and validator coverage indicators across the full K=200 tasks to substantiate the claim that the sampled pool produced a ceiling regime.
required_revisions: Add an aggregated summary (counts and percentages) of task difficulty levels (e.g., medium/hard/very_hard) and validator coverage indicators computed directly from the archived execution/scoring/*.json artifacts for all K=200 tasks; include a compact table in Results and update any sentences that claim the sample was failure‑poor to reference this table (artifact sources: execution/scoring/*.json, execution/task_manifest.jsonl).

Insert an explicit single sentence in the Abstract and another in the Conclusion stating that the preregistered confirmatory hypothesis H1 was not supported (i.e., no detectable marginal effect of G→V→R vs LLM‑only under the tested task/model/validator regime), referencing the primary paired outcome (n11=200,n10=0,n01=0,n00=0; McNemar p=1.00).
optional_revisions: Consider adding a compact table listing the top 10 representative task IDs with difficulty metadata, parsed_command_count, and validator.violation_count to aid rapid external auditing (artifacts available under execution/scoring/ and execution/task_manifest.jsonl).

Add an explicit brief pointer (file path + SHA‑256) to analysis/paired_contingency_table.csv and analysis/condition_summary.csv in the manuscript body where those results are discussed to facilitate artifact locating by readers.

Shortly discuss (one paragraph) how an interactive generator–verifier estimand or sampling of weaker LLMs would change the experimental contract and enable measuring closed‑loop verifier utility; reference preserved artifacts that would enable replaying such alternative designs.
